scope: Additive production-campaign contract successor that binds the nine-output Section 5.4 production-science deck through planner, exact-deck resource pilots, registered-launch review, execution handoff, admission, and analyzer stages. It expands the runtime-critical PIC, source-term, EOS, MHD, AMR, load-balancing, problem-generator, output, and analysis source closure; supersedes the future-campaign shock-front sign rule with the strongest negative density gradient; freezes fail-closed DSA, Bell, scaling, and I/O gates with explicit threshold provenance; and preregisters an eight-seed paired-triad envelope with a resource-only pre-launch freeze and honest small-N reporting rules. It modifies no historical artifact and grants no authority.

end_to_end_contract.predecessor_rule: Every stage consumes, validates, and hashes its predecessor record before emitting its own source-local fail-closed record.
end_to_end_contract.production_deck_rule: Every stage binds the exact nine-output successor deck and launch path; the six-output historical deck is rejected.
end_to_end_contract.mandatory_core_campaign_matrix: three paired qualifying seeds across coarse-uniform, three-level AMR, and fine-uniform variants for nine required attempts
end_to_end_contract.reserve_seed_envelope: five additional ordered paired seeds are preregistered through a maximum of eight complete triads and twenty-four possible attempts; the maximum is not promised
end_to_end_contract.resource_only_freeze_rule: after excluded exact-deck scaling and I/O pilots and before any qualifying launch or output inspection, freeze N as the largest complete paired-triad prefix from three through eight fitting the measured global ten-thousand node-hour ledger after all other registered campaign reservations and the stated contingency
end_to_end_contract.post_execution_rule: once qualifying execution begins, expansion, contraction, seed dropping, and science-output-driven sample-size changes are forbidden

mandatory_core_triads.rationale: Three paired seeds are the mandatory repeatability core and not a literature-derived sample size.

maximum_preregistered_triads.rationale: Eight is the maximum reserve envelope, not a promised run count or a literature-derived sample size.

global_node_hour_cap.rationale: The global project ledger cap is an engineering control with no scientific literature origin.

contingency.rule: reserve the greater of one measured complete-triad cost or fifteen percent of the frozen Q011 production cost
contingency.rationale: The stated contingency protects complete paired retries without seed dropping and has no scientific literature origin.

statistical_and_resource_design.N_equals_3_reporting: report every paired value and contrast plus the observed range; make narrow claims about these three realizations only and no broad population inference
statistical_and_resource_design.N_greater_than_3_reporting: before launch freeze the exact two-sided distribution-free order-statistic interval for the median paired contrast at nominal eighty-percent coverage, report achieved finite-sample coverage, document ties, and avoid asymptotic-normal or standard-error claims

coverage: particle push deposition tasks and boundaries
top-level EOS dispatch and ideal-MHD EOS
MHD stages driver and task scheduler
AMR refinement migration and load balancing
shock problem generator and nine-output path
runtime_source_closure.admission_binding: The v2 source-local admission record includes the complete exact runtime source closure and fails closed on any member drift.

physical_preregistration.predecessor_positive_gradient_rule: superseded for the future successor campaign only
physical_preregistration.gate_state: all blocked pending registered runtime evidence; no measurements inspected and no passes recorded

threshold_provenance.numeric_threshold_rule: Every numeric science or admission criterion carries one allowed source category and an explicit rationale.
threshold_provenance.literature_boundary: Literature-comparison values identify published observables or sampling epochs only unless a primary source explicitly supplies a numerical tolerance. AthenaK-selected release screens are explicitly labeled as such.

resource_pilot_contract.compute_scaling: three full-geometry 512-cycle output-suppressed decks with explicit node ladders
resource_pilot_contract.io_scaling: three reduced-transverse full-time decks retaining the exact nine-output cadence
resource_pilot_contract.campaign_size_freeze_binding: registered exact-deck pilot resource measurements are required inputs to the resource-only freeze; pilot physical outputs remain excluded from qualifying science

maximum_consumed_node_hours.rationale: The cap is the preregistered Q011 engineering-pilot budget inside the project-wide node-hour ceiling and has no scientific literature origin.

historical_immutability.verification: The central contract hash-verifies sixteen protected historical artifacts and tests before building the pipeline.

adversarial_coverage: unaffordable mandatory core and non-largest freeze selection
post-freeze expansion, contraction, and seed dropping
N=3 descriptive-only and N>3 exact interval-estimator reporting rules

remaining_risks: Exact combined MHD plus CR conservation is not yet integrated and qualified for dynamic AMR and load balancing.
Registered Frontier MPI HIP evidence for dynamic AMR migration, load balancing, restart, reflection, and escape remains absent.
The production deck still sets particle load-balance cost per particle to zero; the exact-deck resource pilot must select and validate a production value.
The scaling and I/O pilots are materialized but not executed, so node counts, memory margin, walltime, output cost, and the production campaign budget remain unclosed.
The resource-only campaign-size freeze has not been recorded from a measured post-pilot global ledger; the source-local executable plan therefore remains the mandatory three-seed, nine-run core.
All DSA and Bell gate records are source-local preregistrations only. No registered production raw artifacts have been admitted or scientifically evaluated.
AthenaK-selected numerical release thresholds are not literature-derived universal tolerances.
